reviews.t: Beard soap! Who knew? We didn't!
reviews.x: I picked this up for my husband as a "spa treat" since beards and face masks don't go together. We both love it. He likes feeling better moisturised. Both of us like the fresh (not strong when it rinses off!) mint smell, the softer beard, and added manageability so he looks sharp.  My husband and I didn't know there's a better way to care for beards! I'm planning to give my dad a bar for father's day.
This product actually helped make my beard healthy and a little goes a long way.

I had a pretty healthy beard before this arrived.  I followed all the directions on my other wash and oil to keep it looking and feeling good.  Ever since I starting using this soap (pretty much just a fancy bar soap at that) my beard has become brittle and dry.  Hairs are breaking non-stop and my mustache is too dry to style. The skin under and around my beard is drying out as well, I never had this problem before.  If you take pride in how your beard looks and feels stay away from this soap.

reviews.t: Go for it... you will like it.
reviews.x: Highly recommend this beard soap! I tried other brands before trying this one and I won't go back to any other beard wash. Been using my first bar for months, it goes a long way. I wash my beard about every other day so it lasts a long time. Love the lather and doesn't dry my beard out like others have said in their reviews. I do also use beard oil/conditioner in the winter or when I grow my beard out. Now if I can find a beard oil that I like as much as this soap.

About my beard: I have a short beard that is very coarse and coiled. If I don't wash it often, I end up getting painful. ingrown hairs. This wash produces a nice lather which helps make my beard manageable for combing and oiling. The scent of the wash is mild so much so that's nearly unnoticeable. I like it to be a tad more fragrance. I typically wash my beard each morning, and the bar last for a while.

This is the third bar I have purchase from the Honest for, line. The first two bars I used entirely. They keep my beard smelling and feeling amazing. The scent of this bar is perfect. Often the scents of mint and tea tree can be over powering. But not these. They managed the combination perfectly.

I like the scent, but it dries out my beard unlike the original scent that seemed to have more oils in the bar. I know these are made in small batches but the moisturizing properties need to be more consistent.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soap for producing a rich, quick lather and leaving the beard clean and manageable.
Many customers highlight that the bar is very long-lasting and a little goes a long way.
The scent is commonly described as pleasant and mild, with mint and tea tree noted as well-balanced rather than overpowering.
A few reviewers report the soap dries out or makes the beard brittle, contrary to claims of moisturizing.
Several customers note the soap helped soften their beard and calm skin irritation.
